SPLICE: A Human Curated Benchmark for Probing Visual Reasoning in VLMs
	


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

SPLICE (Sequential Processing for Learning and Inference in Chronological Events) is a human-curated benchmark designed to evaluate the temporal and causal reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). The core task is to reorder a set of shuffled video segments from a single procedural event into their correct chronological sequence. SPLICE dataset
